name: ensemble_v17
information: v17 = v15 + four corrections that passed the nested, date-blocked test (Munhak main-stadium concert profile, grave-visit days at station 3122 blended towards the excess of the other lunar holidays, large-store closure Sundays at 3131 / 3206, 22h at 3139 at half strength). No leaderboard score is read or stored. v17e = v17 + the entries below, which rest on realised facts of the evaluation period and on ridership before the cutoff only; they cannot be validated on any fold. Against v16e the entries for PLAVE, the fan match of 17 October and the Neungheodae festival use end times / venue confirmed from sources.

scenarios.note: most leave after the game or a short ceremony (wave by 20:39)
a third leaves at the end of the game, the rest after fireworks ending about 20:45-20:50
a quarter leaves at the end of the game, the rest after fireworks ending about 21:00

extras.basis: Game 17:30-20:23 (2 h 53 min), attendance 23,300, sold out (namu.wiki, page opened and checked 2026-11-13); awards ceremony and fireworks after the game (club notice of 2026-10-13, checked), their end is not documented.  Crowd leaving by this station from the home-game relation of the training period (boardings in the two hours after the end = 0.263 x attendance + 204, about 6,300).  The scenarios differ in how many stay for the fireworks and when these end.  Split of the leaving crowd between hour cells: outputs/ensemble_v15/external/exit_split_by_end_minute.csv (home games of the training period: an end at :30-:39 puts 78 % into the hour of the end, :40-:49 37 %, :50-:59 18 %, :00-:09 95 %).

extras.basis: The 2025 race (2025-09-28) gave 713 and 746 boardings at 10h and 11h against 242 and 261 on the neighbouring Sundays (x2.9). The retrained model of v14 already raises these two hours by about 30 %; x1.4 on top brings the forecast to roughly 55 % of the 2025 log effect (one earlier race only).

summer_leave.name: 여름 집단휴가 2주 (평일 7/27~8/7)
summer_leave.basis: Weekday boardings fell in the week holding 1 August and the following week in every year of the daily card data (nine years, mean -0.09 and -0.07 log against mid-July and late August); the mean of the other years reproduced the 2025 fall of our own stations (-0.100 vs -0.107, -0.076 vs -0.075). Per station and hour group, half of the difference between the 2025 fall and the fall the forecast already holds is applied, only where 2025 was deeper. Which of the two weeks is deeper in 2026 is not known, so both get the same shift.

not_applied.name: 서울세계불꽃축제 2026-09-05 (여의도)
not_applied.reason: On the day of the 2025 edition (2025-09-27, Saturday) the night hours 20-23 at 계양 3110, 검암 3207 and 부평 3120 were 0.9-1.6 times an ordinary Saturday with no return wave at 22-23h at 계양 (0.93 at 22h); 부평 was raised through the whole afternoon and the median station was 1.04. One day, mixed with other events of that Saturday: not applied.
